ayahs.arabic: يسٓ
ayahs.translit: Yaseen

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Ya, Seen

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Waalqurani alhakeemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the wise Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Innaka lamina almursaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On a straight path

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

ayahs.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمࣰ ا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see

ayahs.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَأَجۡرࣲ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register

ayahs.arabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.translit: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And we are not responsible except for clear notification

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers

ayahs.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided

ayahs.arabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.translit: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translit: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ
ayahs.translit: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me

ayahs.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

ayahs.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished

ayahs.arabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبࣰّ ا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs

ayahs.arabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful

ayahs.arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk

ayahs.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
ayahs.translit: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.translit: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةࣲ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return

ayahs.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation

ayahs.arabic: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.translit: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches

ayahs.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبࣲّ رَّحِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals

ayahs.arabic: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلࣰّ ا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: This is the Hellfire which you were promised

ayahs.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny

ayahs.arabic: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيࣰّ ا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ وَقُرۡءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners

ayahs.arabic: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلࣰ ا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translit: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.translit: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is

ayahs.arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned
